steps: Source-bound raw offset and complete actor/group identity list; cancel leaves all author files unchanged.
SET moves all placement actors after local overrides, preserves unrelated placement/templates/UUIDs, reviews three narrow locales, applies memory then saves only recipe.
DELETE restores missing default [0,0], keeps local overrides and all identities, and changes disk only through ordinary Save.
Absent offset is not silently inserted; explicit zero SET and explicit zero DELETE are distinct author changes even when all scene positions stay equal.
Expanded out-of-range coordinates and silent unreviewed edits fail closed; normal Save detects external writes and retains both disk and local draft.
limitations: Real HTTP editor and Chrome only; no installed Tauri window or Android device acceptance.
One recipe placement offset SET/removal only; no actor/group structure or scale transform, executable recipe build or cross-file transaction.
